value: DECISION: Beads architecture — embedded Dolt + GitHub git remote. Rejected shared Dolt SQL server. Each environment runs its own embedded Dolt; GitHub is the remote via refs/dolt/data. Sync: bd dolt push/pull. NEVER mount host .beads/ into containers. NEVER share a Dolt SQL server. Host metadata.json: {backend:dolt, dolt_database:lg}. BD_REMOTE env var with fallback to REPO_URL in entrypoint.sh. Committed 52308bb on main.

DECISION: gh auth pattern for headless containers. Set GH_TOKEN=token env var (NOT GITHUB_TOKEN — gh reads GH_TOKEN). Run 'gh auth setup-git' to wire git credential helper. Never embed token in remote URL. gh CLI must be installed in image. Applies to both vessel-driver (Go: exec gh auth setup-git) and entrypoint.sh. Committed 52308bb.

lg-9rt decision: Mayor calls 'lg invoke' as primary dispatch (validates agents against .github/agents/). Falls back to 'bd create --labels' only when: (a) lg not in PATH, or (b) mayor needs structured description fields not yet exposed by lg invoke flags. Mayor NEVER calls bd create without --labels; unlabeled beads waste a dispatcher vessel cycle.

lg-9rt decision: Legion ships as BOTH a skill (.github/skills/legion/SKILL.md) and a mayor agent (.github/agents/mayor.agent.md). Skill = passive routing context, agent = opinionated coordinator persona. Both required: skill survives compaction, agent provides judgment. Mayor is human-facing (human intent -> bead); dispatcher vessel (lg-kjb) is Archon-internal (unlabeled bead -> labeled bead). Mayor labels explicitly so dispatcher is bypassed.

lg-b47 redesign (per lg-fzl ADR): Inquisitor is a vessel, not a vessel-driver feature. Archon watcher creates review issue on worker exit 0. Inquisitor vessel does ALL review work via terminal (git diff, gh pr merge --squash, bd close) in ACP session. vessel-driver unchanged for Inquisitor vs worker — role prompt is the only difference. Remove gh pr merge and review bead creation from vessel-driver design.

lg-h8u role system constraint (per lg-fzl ADR): vessel-driver provides ZERO fallback for domain ops. Every worker role prompt MUST explicitly instruct: git add -A && git commit && git push origin legion/$ISSUE_ID && bd close $ISSUE_ID. Reviewer role prompts MUST include gh pr merge and bd close instructions. The role bead system prompt is the enforcement mechanism. Existing ADRs (lg-8wy, lg-w7y, lg-a0t) are unaffected.

SESSION STATE (2026-03-13): Main branch at 52308bb (pushed). Two commits this session: cbec20f (remove dolt-init/) and 52308bb (replace shared Dolt SQL server with GitHub-backed embedded Dolt). Build is clean (go build ./... exits 0). Open follow-up issues: app-5mg (guard REPO_URL in entrypoint.sh), app-1km (delete transient markdown files: BLOCKER_RESOLUTION.md HANDOFF_TO_MEPHISTO.md SPAWN_CYCLE_PS1_HANDOFF.md). Also open: app-os2 (MVP.2 ACP handshake), app-46d (MVP.3 end-to-end). NEXT ACTION: rebuild images (cross-compile vessel-driver linux binary, docker build Dockerfile.vessel-copilot), then docker compose up and run lg invoke to test spawn cycle with new embedded Dolt init.

vessel-driver boundary (lg-fzl, ADR: docs/adr-vessel-driver-boundary.md): vessel-driver = ACP adapter ONLY. entrypoint.sh owns git clone/credential/bd init. Agent owns git add/commit/push/bd close/gh. Archon watcher owns exit code handling. lg-b47 BLOCKED (Inquisitor = vessel not vd feature; watcher creates review issues). lg-h8u: role prompts MUST include git push + bd close instructions. lg-9zy UNAFFECTED (LEGION_AGENT stays in vd). Exit codes: 0=end_turn 1=internal 2=refusal 3=max_tokens 4=timeout.
